description: This file implements a WebRTC client controller for establishing peer-to-peer connections, managing signaling, ICE candidates, and connection states, primarily for use within a WebRTC-based communication system in a go module.

classes.name: Signaling
classes.description: Holds channels for signaling messages, ICE servers, and client ICE servers for establishing a WebRTC connection.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Manages the WebRTC peer connection, signaling lifecycle, and connection states, including ICE candidate handling and offer/answer exchange.

classes.name: Observer
classes.description: Interface for handling events such as ADB data channel creation, errors, failure, and connection close notifications.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Represents an active WebRTC connection, encapsulating the controller managing the peer connection.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes signaling event handlers, connection state monitoring, and initiates the offer/answer process.

methods.name: recvLoop
methods.description: Listens for incoming signaling messages and processes them accordingly.

methods.name: stopGoRoutines
methods.description: Stops signaling goroutines by closing channels.

methods.name: closeSendCh
methods.description: Closes the signaling send channel safely.

methods.name: sendSigMsg
methods.description: Sends a signaling message over the send channel.

methods.name: onOffer
methods.description: Handles an incoming offer by setting it as remote description and creating an answer.

methods.name: onAnswer
methods.description: Handles an incoming answer by setting it as remote description.

methods.name: onICECandidate
methods.description: Handles an incoming ICE candidate by adding it to the peer connection.

methods.name: sendICECandidate
methods.description: Send ICE candidate to the signaling server.

methods.name: NewConnection
methods.description: Creates a new WebRTC connection with default logger (stderr).

methods.name: NewConnectionWithLogger
methods.description: Creates a new WebRTC connection with a custom logger.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the peer connection to terminate the WebRTC session.
